newsitem.title: USA: Paxson Comms expanding broadcast network.
newsitem.headline: Paxson Comms expanding broadcast network.

text.p: Paxson Communications Corp said on Thursday it is expanding its inTV Network with the acquisition of three television stations and a radio station in separate transactions.
Paxson said it acquired KCMY TV-29, serving the Sacramento, Calif. market; KOOG TV-30, serving the Salt Lake City market; and WNAL TV-44 of Birmingham, Ala.
In a separate transaction, Paxson said it plans to acquire from InterMart Broadcasting First Coast Inc, WPVJ 106.5-FM of Jacksonville, Fla.
This transaction will allow Paxson to expand its holdings in Jacksonville to six radio stations, including four FM stations and two AM stations, Paxson said.

After completing these and other previously announced acquisitions, Paxson's inTV Network will include 44 owned, operated or affiliated television stations in markets reaching over 49.7 million television households, Paxson said.
Paxson's radio group will operate 39 radio stations including 35 in the state of Florida, it said.
Terms of the separate deals were not disclosed.
